During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''enslaver''' visited [[Carosi XII]], where they proceeded to threaten a [[Unidentified patient (Carosi XII)|patient]] of the [[Carosite]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]], [[Tamo Lan]]. To protect his patient, Lan was forced to kill the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]].
